name: Noahs Ark
overview: The account of Noah's Ark reveals God's grace toward Noah, a righteous and upright man who walked faithfully with God in a corrupt generation. God gave Noah precise instructions for building the ark, demonstrating His sovereign authority and Noah's obedience in carrying out every command. The ark served as a means of salvation for Noah, his family, and representatives of clean and unclean animals, highlighting God's judgment on sin and His provision for preservation.
